business_problem: Convert Human Digital Business is Grupo Dreamers' digital agency, specializing in connecting creativity, technology, data, and performance with one core objective: to unlock our clients' business potential through digital, turning opportunities into growth and meaningful business impact.
solution_summary: Convert Human Digital Business built five AI agents on Google Cloud to answer any marketing question from a single source of truth. When the Google Cloud team presented the platform's semantic layer as a solution to exactly this problem, Convert saw the path forward. Partner Shearwater Data supported the onboarding and implementation from the start. With Google Cloud in place, Convert Human Digital Business built Verus, an analytical intelligence ecosystem that combines Looker's semantic layer, specialized AI agents, and advanced prompt engineering to turn marketing data into governed, traceable answers. BigQuery serves as the data warehouse, holding all marketing and transactional data from Convert's clients. Looker sits on top as the foundation of Verus, with its LookML semantic layer acting as what the team calls a business contract written for the AI.

solution_components.name: Gemini Enterprise
solution_components.role: Provides the reasoning or generation layer used for classification, orchestration, content generation, or analysis.

solution_components.name: BigQuery
solution_components.role: Serves as the governed analytics and storage layer for high-volume operational data, features, and reporting.

solution_components.name: Looker
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, governed metrics, or natural-language analytics on top of the shared data model.

solution_components.name: LookML
solution_components.role: Defines the semantic business model that keeps AI and analytics answers consistent and traceable.

solution_components.name: Google Workspace
solution_components.role: Provides the collaboration surface where teams review outputs and work with AI assistance.
